entries.text: Publish the v0.33.0 changelog, and pin the signing identity
revert: the display name stays ClaudeNotch
feat: the menu bar shows the app's own name instead of a hardcoded one
feat: the app's display name is "AI Agent Notch", read from the bundle
fix: the release no longer replaces Info.plist's build variables with literals
feat: the project opens in Xcode, and fixes a bug that would have broken notarized builds
feat: releases can be built and notarized on CI instead of a laptop
feat: the release can notarize and staple, once there is an account to do it with
